57:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, with our worries out of the way...! Let's give it everything again today...」

57:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of $$ガロード$$! You really know the proper way to do business!」

57:t_10:21.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Heh... I may not look it, but I'm the guy who tried to sell a Gundam, you know.」

58:t_000:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Look at that swarm! Those guys are planning to attack the fleet!」

58:t_000:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「There are pirate machines mixed in, too! Did they get bought off!?」

58:t_000:2.en:
$$リジット$$
「Fleet Commander...! What $$サイデリアル$$ is after is...!」

58:t_001:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「As long as I'm around, there's no way I'm letting them through here!」

58:t_001:2.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Do your best, $$ガロード$$, $$パーラ$$!」

58:t_001:3.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Take down the pirates and $$サイデリアル$$ both!」

58:t_002:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Fighting $$サイデリアル$$ is our job.」

58:t_002:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「On top of that, we owe the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ for a night's lodging and a meal.」

58:t_002:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If they and the pirates are going after the fleet, then we will be the ones to face them.」

58:t_002:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Heh... That's what I like to hear!」

58:t_002:5.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$, what is the intruder who came out of the treasure doing?」

58:t_002:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「People from the fleet are keeping watch on him. He shouldn't be able to try anything rash.」

58:t_002:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is also possible to use this confusion to withdraw.]

58:t_002:9.en:
$$レド$$
[No... We'll hold and observe the situation. Be ready to move at any time.]

58:t_002:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To all units. Our objective is to protect the fleet.」

58:t_002:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Do not pursue too far. Secure our defenses first.」

58:t_003:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That position is the first line of defense. Do not allow the enemy to break through.」

58:t_003:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Roger! I'll protect $$ティファ$$ and the fleet no matter what!」

58:t_004:0.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Nice, $$ガロード$$! Go get 'em, hunks!」

58:t_004:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Still, not moving even in this situation... What is that guy thinking?」

58:t_004:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What is with that person...」

58:t_004:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Warning. A unit approaching at high speed from underwater has been detected.]

58:t_005:0.en:
$$メルティ$$
「What do we do, $$エイミー$$! Those guys are going to attack the fleet!」

58:t_005:1.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's all right, $$メルティ$$. I'm sure $$ガロード$$ and the others will protect us.」

58:t_005:2.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Still, not moving even in this situation... What is that guy thinking?」

58:t_005:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What is with that person...」

58:t_005:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$

58:t_006:0.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Nice, $$ガロード$$! Go get 'em, hunks!」

58:t_006:1.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Those new people who showed up are strong, too.」

58:t_006:2.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Still, not moving even in this situation... What is that guy thinking?」

58:t_006:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What is with that person...」

58:t_006:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Warning. A unit approaching at high speed from underwater has been detected.]

58:t_007:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hahaha! Learn the full measure of my power!」

58:t_008:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That guy...! He's the one who attacked us the other day!」

58:t_008:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Did you see that magnificent surprise attack! You will regret siding with $c in the next world!」

58:t_009:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「The treasure moved!? Was someone else riding in it all along!?」

58:t_010:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Damn! That bastard got aboard!」

58:t_010:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The unit that launched the surprise attack is confirmed to be $$サイデリアル$$. It is judged to be their commander's unit.]

58:t_010:4.en:
$$レド$$
[Striking them is a strategic objective of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. Let's do it.]

58:t_010:5.en:
$$レド$$
[Wherever this place is, I will fulfill my duty as a soldier of the Alliance.]

58:t_011:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Gh...! Why is a $$マシンキャリバー$$ out in the frontier of the galaxy!?」

58:t_012:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That black robot is the treasure $$ベローズ$$ and $$ガロード$$ hauled up, isn't it?」

58:t_012:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Is it going to fight $$サイデリアル$$?」

58:t_012:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ガロード$$, stay on that guy! If he makes any strange move, stop him!」

58:t_013:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Hey! You there, can you hear me!? If you plan to take those guys on, lend us a hand!」

58:t_013:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Data re-collated. There are differences in the details, but it is judged to be an allied unit.]

58:t_013:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[That unit, or a derivative model of it, is registered as an allied unit of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.]

58:t_013:4.en:
$$レド$$
[Is an ally who came to this planet for some reason piloting it?]

58:t_013:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Oh... Looks like you've decided to cooperate.」

58:t_014:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'll handle the backup, so you move however you like.」

58:t_014:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What...? That's a weird way of talking.」

58:t_014:3.en:
$$レド$$
[What did he say at the end?]

58:t_014:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[He commented that Ensign $$レド$$'s reply was strange. Inferred to concern the language pattern, not the content.]

58:t_014:5.en:

[If you ask me, those guys are the ones who are strange.]
